title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Red Razz 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Red Razz from Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN range celebrates the bright, ruby tang of fresh Raspberry in a flavour-packed e-liquid that uncannily captures summer in a bottle. Experience the unmistakable sweetness and succulent juiciness of freshly picked raspberries. This e-liquid’s 40VG/60PG formulation delivers the perfect balance of flavour and cloud production while the nicotine salt formulation ensures a super-smooth and comfortable throat sensation. Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN e-liquids are perfect for use in starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. BAR EDTN is a mouth-watering collection of nic salt e-liquids inspired by Riot Squad’s hugely popular disposable Riot Bar flavours . Just like those Riot Bars, Bar EDTN keeps the flavours simple, sweet, and deliciously satisfying, so you always know how your e-juice will taste before you buy it. If you love this flavour, why not treat yourself to the others in Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN collection? From super-refreshing Watermelon Ice to a classic Cherry Cola and smooth and creamy Mango Vanilla, whatever your taste in e-liquid, BAR EDTN has an incredible flavour waiting for you.
